note: Cross-game radio manifest. Single source of truth — games load this + radio.js and never change when new stations/tracks are added. Tracks stream from their source URLs (no bundling). 4 stations: Polkahole (default) + the 3 Machine Elves originals. Originals are root-relative (served from /games/popper/original/) so any game page can reach them.

stations.name: Polkahole
stations.note: Single-track repeat until a wider station selection is picked. radio.js wraps a 1-track station, so this loops on its own.

stations.name: Fairyland
stations.note: Machine Elves original chiptune #1 (rendered from the in-game MusicSys). 1-track station, loops on its own.

stations.name: Sparkle Rush
stations.note: Machine Elves original chiptune #2 (rendered from the in-game MusicSys). 1-track station, loops on its own.

stations.note: Machine Elves original chiptune #3 (rendered from the in-game MusicSys). 1-track station, loops on its own.
